NewHomework-Desktop.dc.html.title: 3b · New homework · step 2 Questions (one at a time)

n1.text:
Order: the content tree comes first (Course > Chapter > Lesson), because every homework lives in one lesson. The tree only adds, renames, reorders and deletes Chapters and Lessons. What goes inside a lesson (videos, files) is the lesson editor, later.

Homework = a list of questions: Multiple choice (graded automatically) and Essay (a text box, plus one image per question if the teacher allows it, up to 5 MB). Every homework has a deadline. Options per homework: allow after the deadline (kept as Missed the deadline), solutions right after submit or after the deadline, and tries: one time, fix mistakes, or from zero. Student photos are never edited. The whole course gets it (no Groups in V1).

New homework is a 4-step wizard like the admin panel: Details, Questions, Rules, Solutions, then Review. One step on screen at a time, one question at a time.

n2.text:
Safety rules shown on the boards:
- After the deadline, solutions open only to students who already handed in. A late student sees them right after handing in.
- With tries on, solutions open after the last try or after the deadline, so nobody reads the answers and then retries. Unused tries end at the deadline; 'allow after the deadline' covers a first hand-in only.
- The latest try counts. Every try stays in the history.
- A lesson with homework that students answered cannot be deleted (the database refuses it).
- Once a student has started, editing the homework makes a new version.
- Assistants: correcting and releasing become permissions, on by default. There is no assistants screen yet, so the switches come with that screen.
